name: What kind of tools do plumbers use to clear standing water clogs?

mainEntity.name: What kind of tools do plumbers use to clear standing water clogs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional plumbers use a range of specialized tools to effectively clear standing water clogs. For common clogs, they might use a plumber's snake or auger, which is a flexible cable that can break up or retrieve obstructions. For more stubborn or deeper clogs, hydro-jetting equipment is used, which blasts high-pressure water through the pipes to clean them thoroughly. Video inspection cameras can also be used to locate the exact source and nature of the clog.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbers use tools like augers or snakes for common clogs, and hydro-jetting for tougher blockages, sometimes with video inspection.
